newsitem.title: UK: Collins & Brown sets debut premium.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Brown sets debut premium.

text.p: Shares in publishing group Collins & Brown Plc set a premium to their issue price on their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market on Friday.
The stock was quoted at 165p by 1600 GMT compared with an issue price of 110p, which valued the company at 4.5 million stg.
"We are delighted to see the stock going to a premium," said chief executive Cameron Brown, "now we have to get on with running the business."
